description: Public catalog of analytic studies of Madhyasth Darshan (Co-existentialism). Streamable HTTP at /mcp exposes read-only catalog tools (search_studies, list_studies, get_study, get_study_outline, get_glossary, get_start_here, get_cite) and resources. Markdown bodies are studies://study/{slug}. Write APIs are for humans; see /auth.md.
